pull.title: jobs: alert on new saved-search matches
pull.body:
## Summary
- add opt-in alerts to saved search presets
- persist publication events in a transactional `job_publication_outbox`
- process outbox events asynchronously with a scheduled worker after job publication commits
- match query, category (including parent categories) and price filters without reading or exposing exact location
- exclude the job author from matching their own publication
- persist unique `(saved_search, job)` delivery records to make retries idempotent
- create durable `SAVED_SEARCH_MATCH` notifications and reuse existing realtime notification preferences
- add a web toggle for enabling/disabling alerts per saved search
- add Flyway V22 and matcher/service regression coverage

## Safety / architecture
- job creation only writes the outbox record in the same transaction; user scanning never runs on the publication request path
- exact coordinates, private labels and route geometry are not part of matching or notification payloads
- duplicate delivery is prevented at both application and database levels
- realtime delivery can be muted while durable inbox notifications remain stored

## Validation
Run full Maven verify, frontend lint/build, Flyway/PostgreSQL migrations and existing runtime/payment smoke gates. Do not merge unless required checks are green.
